"Failure se darr nahi; try na karne se darr."
Woh prajati jeevit nahi rehti jo sabse majboot hai, balki woh jo sabse aasaani se dhal jaati hai.
Disappointment kabhi-kabhi better direction ka signpost hota.
Chahe tum socho ki tum kar sakte ho, ya tum socho ki tum nahi kar sakte—tum sahi ho.
"Chhoti discipline, daily repeat—badi achievements."
"Tumhari habits future decide karegi."
"Future depend karta hai—today tum kya karte."
Chahe 'kar sakta' socho, ya 'nahi'—
Dimag sab kuch hai. Tum jo sochte ho, wahi ban jaate ho.
